title: What is an LLM (large language model)? | 50agents
description: An LLM is an AI model trained on huge amounts of text to predict the next word. On its own it only writes; it acts only when a product gives it tools.
h1: What is an LLM (large language model)?
definition: An LLM, a large language model, is an AI model trained on huge amounts of text to write, summarise, sort and answer.
Alone it only produces text; it acts only through tools a product gives it.

example.ask: Set up an AI agent that reads last week's payments in Stripe every Monday at 9:00 and emails me the totals and what changed
example.why: The LLM writes what changed; reading Stripe and sending email are its tools.

build.name: Monday revenue
build.line: last week in Stripe, in one email
does: Reads last week's payments in Stripe
Compares them with the week before
Emails you the totals and what changed
